fields.question: Can this information confirm whether my particular loss is covered?
fields.answer: General insurance information cannot determine whether your specific loss is covered. The cause of the damage, your selected coverages, policy limits, exclusions, and conditions all matter. Review your policy contract, and contact your insurer or agent for help with your situation.
fields.formalWording: Coverage for a specific loss is determined from the applicable policy and the facts of the loss. This general overview is not a coverage decision or a promise of payment.
fields.explanation:
For example, water damage does not have a single answer that applies to every situation. A sudden plumbing problem, maintenance-related damage, and flooding can be treated differently. Ask for a review of your policy rather than relying on a general search result.

fields.question: How do collision coverage and deductibles work together?
fields.answer: Collision coverage can help repair or replace your vehicle after a covered collision with another vehicle or object. The deductible is the part you pay. A higher deductible generally means taking on more of that cost yourself in exchange for a lower premium.
fields.formalWording: Collision coverage is governed by the policy terms and the selected deductible. Coverage and payment for an individual loss require review of the actual policy and circumstances.
fields.explanation: Consider both the value of your vehicle and the amount you could comfortably pay after a covered accident. Compare the same deductible when comparing quotes, and discuss lender requirements if the vehicle is financed or leased.
fields.sourceLink: <link text="Liberty Mutual: collision insurance coverage" linktype="external" url="https://www.libertymutual.com/vehicle/auto-insurance/coverage/collision-insurance" />

fields.question: What should I compare when shopping for car insurance?
fields.answer: Compare similar coverage limits, deductibles, and optional protections when reviewing car insurance quotes. Price matters, but so does the protection you choose. Your location, driving history, vehicle, and selected coverages can affect the quote.
fields.formalWording: Quoted premiums depend on individual rating information and selected coverage. Comparing unlike limits or deductibles does not provide an equivalent coverage comparison.
fields.explanation: Start with your coverage needs. Review liability limits, collision and comprehensive deductibles, and any optional coverage you want. Then compare quotes on the same basis, and ask an agent about differences you do not understand.
fields.sourceLink: <link text="Liberty Mutual: car insurance options" linktype="external" url="https://www.libertymutual.com/vehicle/auto-insurance" />
fields.nextStep: <link text="Prepare for an auto quote" linktype="external" url="/get-a-quote" querystring="product=auto&source=compare-auto-insurance-quotes" />

fields.question: What does comprehensive car insurance help cover?
fields.answer: Comprehensive coverage can help with damage to your vehicle from events other than a collision, such as theft, vandalism, hail, or a falling tree. The coverage you select, your deductible, and your policy terms determine how a covered loss is handled.
fields.formalWording: Comprehensive coverage is subject to the applicable deductible, coverage limits, exclusions, and policy conditions. A lender may require it for a financed or leased vehicle.
fields.explanation: Think about the risks to your car beyond a crash. Review the coverage and deductible in your quote or policy, and ask about anything unclear. This overview cannot confirm whether a particular incident is covered.

fields.question: What should I review when choosing auto insurance in Florida?
fields.answer: Florida has its own auto insurance requirements and coverage considerations. Review Personal Injury Protection and Property Damage Liability, along with optional protection for your vehicle and other risks. An agent can help you consider coverage beyond the state minimum.
fields.formalWording: This is general Florida information, not a determination of the coverage required for an individual driver or the protection provided by a particular policy.
fields.explanation: Start with the Florida-specific overview instead of assuming guidance from another state applies. Review your quote and policy carefully, and ask about limits, deductibles, exclusions, and coverage that fits how you use your vehicle.

fields.answer: Use Illinois-specific guidance when comparing car insurance. Review liability and uninsured motorist bodily injury coverage, and consider the protection you want for your own vehicle. The state minimum is a starting point for a conversation about your needs.
fields.formalWording: Illinois coverage requirements and the policy terms apply. General information does not replace a review of your limits, deductibles, selected coverages, and individual circumstances.
